thread:
tara: :rotating_light: EU-WEST gpu nodepool at 100% capacity, new pods are Pending.
ben: I'm seeing `CrashLoopBackOff` for a few jobs too. Any recent rollout?
marta: No rollouts. Cluster-autoscaler logs show scaleDownDisabled for gpu-pool.
ryan: @tara can you paste `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and `kubectl get pods -o wide | grep Pending`?
tara: ```
$ kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=gpu-eu-west
NAME                               STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION
gpunode-12x                        Ready    <none>   12d   v1.26
gpunode-13x                        Ready    <none>   12d   v1.26
...
$ kubectl get pods --all-namespaces | grep Pending
inference-abc-0        0/1     Pending     0          0s
batch-train-256        0/1     Pending     0          0s
``` 
kapil: cluster-autoscaler shows `no more capacity: insufficient gpustype/gpu`. Looks like quota in eu-west reached.
ben: Is this a cloud quota or AZ imbalance? Logs: `scale up err: failed to launch instances: InsufficientInstanceCapacity`.
ryan: If it's capacity, autoscaler won't create new nodes. We can temporarily move non-critical jobs to a different nodepool or evict low-priority pods.
marta: Suggest: taint a few nodes and move high-priority inference pods via `kubectl cordon`/`drain` on non-gpu nodes? But inference needs GPUs.
tara: Plan: 1) Identify and evict non-prod batch jobs (priorityclass=low). 2) Create emergency fallback nodepool `gpu-eu-west-burst` with different instance type. 3) Contact cloud quota owner to request capacity increase.
ben: I'm starting eviction for batch jobs: `kubectl delete pod -l app=batch,env=staging --force --grace-period=0`.
infra-bot: Deploy job eviction-controller started by ben at 1923456795
kapil: I'm provisioning `gpu-eu-west-burst` via infra terraform change and launching spot-backed instances as a temporary measure.
ryan: Watch out for spot churn, but ok as short-term.
tara: After evicting ~12 batch pods we freed 8 GPUs. Pending pods are now scheduling.
ben: Confirmed: inference replicas are up. Still 2 pending — autoscaler is retrying with the new nodepool.
marta: Cost note: using spot for burst will increase preemption risk, added to incident cost channel.
kapil: Filed support ticket for capacity and quota with cloud provider (ticket #CLOUD-9832).
ryan: Postmortem action: add automated fallback nodepool with pre-approved budget and a runbook to trigger it. Assign owners.
tara: Thanks all. I'm keeping the thread open for final verification and cost estimate.
ben: :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Incident closed by tara at 1923456899 — mitigated, monitoring for 30m.
